title: QuestBank
description: Defines a collection of quests for the educational RPG engine (M20). TEACHING NOTE — A quest bank is a content database: the designer authors quest data here and the QuestBaker tool validates and cooks it for the runtime QuestSystem.

version.description: SemVer version of this quest bank file.

title.description: Short display title shown in the quest log HUD.

description.description: Flavour text describing the quest to the player.

isMainQuest.description: True for story-critical quests shown under 'Main Quests' in the HUD.

objectives.description: Ordered list of objectives. The QuestSystem advances through these in order.

xpReward.description: XP granted to the player on quest completion via LevelComponent::GainXP.

gilReward.description: Gil granted to the player on quest completion via CurrencyComponent::EarnGil.

itemRewards.description: Item IDs (matching GameDatabase::GetItems) granted on completion.

prereqQuestIDs.description: Quest IDs that must be complete before this quest can be accepted.

luaCompleteCallback.description: Lua function name called by QuestSystem when this quest completes.

type.description: TEACHING NOTE — Objective type maps to QuestObjectiveType: KILL_ENEMY (matched by CombatSystem::OnEnemyKilled), COLLECT_ITEM (matched by InventorySystem::AddItem), REACH_LOCATION (matched by Zone::OnPlayerEnter).

description.description: Human-readable objective text shown in the quest log HUD.

targetID.description: ID of the target: enemy data ID, item ID, or zone ID depending on type.

requiredCount.description: Number of times the objective must be satisfied.
